Description de l'entreprise
Huxley delivers a world-class recruitment service that adapts to your changing needs. Our teams specialise in IT jobs across a wide range of industries. In Belgium we cover consultancy, freelancers and permanent positions (headhunting). We specialize in placing roles from mid-level management through to C-Suite across a range of disciplines. We also operate as a full service recruitment partner, with capabilities to support sourcing back office and administrative staff. With unrivaled access to a global network of talent and leading industry experts with the latest market knowledge, we give you the strength and agility of a global staffing company with specialists that are dedicated to your local market. This gives you a tailored approach that achieves success for you.
Description de la fonction
Business Analyst Trading & Investing
Want to join the exciting and innovating trading and investing environment within a dynamic online bank? Client's is looking for a Trading and Investing Business Analyst.
Your missions
Participate in the development of new projects related to trading, investing or savings, in collaboration with the Product Owner
Collect and analyze business requirements
Write specifications and functional analysis
Cooperate with both I.T. and Operations teams (contact center, sales, back-office trading) and with other stakeholders (e.g. Legal&compliance, Finance, Risk, Security)
Perform tests and follow-up on I.T. development
Analyze and find solutions dealing with specific issues
Define and conceive improvements
Your profile
Master Degree in Finance/Economics or Engineering
Passionate about banking & markets with a focus on regulatory reporting, compliance and knowledge of crypto trading
Experience in business analysis with proven experience in conducting impact analysis on regulatory reporting, internal procedures documentation and excellent documentation skills
Strong analytical and impact assessment capabilities across systems, processes, and regulations
Overall knowledge about major banking regulations requiring to produce reporting: MICAR, MiFID, EMIR, transaction reporting, AML
Proven ability to facilitate workshops and gather requirements from diverse stakeholders
Experience training and supporting back office and customer service teams on new procedures
Good knowledge of testing & validation technics
Being able to understand how developers work and talk to them
French or Dutch as a mother language and fluent in English
Autonomous (you define and guide actions end-to-end)
Proactive (you propose solutions)
Hybrid system, 50% at home
Brussels
4 months potential extensions.
ASAP Start date
Interested ? Share your updated cv or Apply directly below.
To find out more about Huxley please visit www.huxley.com
